# Tug of War

## Evenly Matched

Two teams grip a rope, dig in, and pull with everything they've got.

The rope doesn't move. Not an inch, either way.

## Not Because Nothing Is Happening

Both teams are pulling hard — real forces, in opposite directions.

**Yet the rope stays exactly where it is.**

How can two forces be doing something and produce no motion at all?
